tldr: Mercury through the 6th house clarifies work, health, stress, routines, and daily maintenance.
body:
When Mercury moves through your 6th house, it puts language around work, health, stress, routines, chores, habits, exhaustion, and what has become hard to maintain. You may notice the condition of your days more clearly: what is sustainable, what is draining you, and what your body keeps trying to report.

Something may need to be said, decided, written, questioned, or understood. It can help you name the question, make the call, or sort through the moving pieces.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for adjusting a routine before it becomes a bigger problem.

The caution: Watch for overthinking the situation until the simple next step disappears. The risk is treating stress as normal just because you have learned how to keep functioning through it.

Mercury moves through this house for a few weeks. Use the mental activity for clarity. Say the thing plainly, then let the answer tell you what comes next.
